moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow 2026 Concludes
moments.blurb: The Commonwealth Games in Glasgow wraps up today after a thrilling two weeks of competition, with Team England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland celebrating numerous medal wins.

angles.name: Medal Haul
angles.copy: It's the final day of the Commonwealth Games 2026 in Glasgow! What an incredible performance from all the home nations. Who was your standout athlete from Team England, Scotland, Wales or Northern Ireland?

angles.name: Local Heroes
angles.copy: Huge shout out to all the athletes who competed at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow – especially those from Wales! The Welsh team picked up four medals yesterday alone, including a one-two in the Women's 25km Points Race.

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Heats Up
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket tournament continues across the UK this week, with men's and women's teams battling it out ahead of the final on August 16th.

angles.name: Weekly Fixtures
angles.copy: Catch The Hundred action this week! London Spirit take on MI London on Thursday and Birmingham Phoenix on Sunday at Lord's. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Welsh Fire Update
angles.copy: The Welsh Fire are in the thick of The Hundred action! Keep up with all the 100-ball excitement as the tournament continues towards the big final on August 16th.

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' has become the longest-running UK number-one single of all time, with nineteen non-consecutive weeks at the top.

angles.name: Chart Record Breaker
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is officially the longest-running UK number-one single EVER, with 19 non-consecutive weeks at the top. An incredible achievement!

angles.name: Sam & Olivia Reign
angles.copy: Nineteen weeks at number one and counting! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean are dominating the charts with 'Rein Me In'. Is it your favourite number one of all time?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, combining music and surfing, takes over Watergate Bay and Fistral Beach in Cornwall from August 5th to 9th.

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: Boardmasters is nearly here! Get ready for a huge week of music and surf action at Watergate Bay and Fistral Beach from August 5th-9th. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Only a few days until Boardmasters brings the biggest names in music to Cornwall! Get your plans sorted for August 5th-9th.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents Summer Series
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents concert series continues in London's Crystal Palace Bowl through August 16th, featuring a diverse lineup including Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, and Lenny Kravitz.

angles.name: Live in London
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is buzzing this week! The 'Palace Bowl Presents' series continues with a massive lineup including Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, and Lenny Kravitz. Who are you going to see?

angles.name: Summer Gigs
angles.copy: London's Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting some epic gigs throughout August! Don't miss out on the summer concert series.

moments.title: The Roots Picnic Comes to London
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8th-9th, bringing its blend of hip hop and culture to the UK.

angles.name: Roots Picnic Debut
angles.copy: Big news for hip hop fans! The legendary Roots Picnic is making its international debut in London this weekend, August 8th-9th, at Crystal Palace Bowl.

angles.name: Hip Hop in the Capital
angles.copy: Get ready for a weekend of culture and music as The Roots Picnic brings its unique vibe to London! August 8th-9th, don't miss it.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Charli XCX
moments.blurb: English pop superstar Charli XCX turns 34 today, August 2nd.

angles.name: Pop Queen's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 34th Birthday to the incredible Charli XCX! From 'Boom Clap' to 'Vroom Vroom', she always delivers. What's your favourite Charli XCX track?

angles.name: Chart-topping Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy Birthday to Charli XCX, who turns 34 today! Her track 'Camera' is also in the latest UK Top 40.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Andy Fairweather-Low
moments.blurb: Welsh music legend Andy Fairweather-Low, known for Amen Corner and his work with Eric Clapton, celebrates his 76th birthday today.

angles.name: Welsh Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: A huge Happy 76th Birthday to Welsh guitar legend Andy Fairweather-Low! From Amen Corner to touring with Eric Clapton, what a career.

moments.title: Happy Birthday Pat Smear
moments.blurb: Pat Smear, influential guitarist for Nirvana and Foo Fighters, turns 67 on August 5th.

angles.name: Rock Legend Birthday
angles.copy: On August 5th, we're celebrating the birthday of rock legend Pat Smear! The guitarist who played with both Nirvana and Foo Fighters turns 67. Which band did you discover him through?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships in Birmingham
moments.blurb: Birmingham will host the prestigious European Athletics Championships from August 10th to 16th, marking the first time the UK has hosted this event.

angles.name: Athletics on Home Soil
angles.copy: Get ready for world-class athletics! The European Athletics Championships come to Birmingham from August 10th-16th – a historic first for the UK. Who are you hoping to see compete?

angles.name: Birmingham Hosts
angles.copy: The UK is hosting the European Athletics Championships for the very first time! All eyes on Birmingham from August 10th-16th.

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Friendlies
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are continuing their pre-season preparations, with Liverpool facing Leeds today in Chicago, ahead of the new season starting August 21st.

angles.name: Pre-Season Action
angles.copy: Pre-season is in full swing! Liverpool take on Leeds today in Chicago as clubs gear up for the Premier League season. Who's looking sharp so far?

angles.name: Football's Back (Almost)
angles.copy: The countdown to the new Premier League season is on! Catch up on all the pre-season friendlies and transfer news as teams fine-tune their squads.
